135:t_1:3.en: ～$$新地球皇国$$　$$ターミナル・ベース$$～

135:t_1:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh... Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha!」

135:t_1:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That bastard $$ダバラーン・タウ$$! He always, always, always poses as a warrior and acts so grand, only to end up like that...!」

135:t_1:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That's all a band of muscleheads like the $$ハイアデス$$ can manage, in the end!」

135:t_1:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「But I am different! I have the strategic skill to subdue any military might!」

135:t_1:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Get carried away and you'll have your feet swept out from under you, $$ギルター$$.」

135:t_1:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「G-General $$サルディアス$$! Did you hear what I just said?!」

135:t_1:10.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course not...! My taste may be poor, but I wouldn't eavesdrop on some middle-aged man's muttering.」

135:t_1:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... Knowing you, I merely assumed you were rejoicing over General $$ダバラーン$$'s defeat.」

135:t_1:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then I bluffed to see how you would react, and bingo! ...That's what happened.」

135:t_1:14.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Listen, $$ギルター$$... The $$ハイアデス$$ are under a different chain of command from us, but they're still our allies.」

135:t_1:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I can't say I approve of rejoicing at their failure.」

135:t_1:16.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I know! That's why I'm going to take to the battlefield myself to make up for his failure!」

135:t_1:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I understand. Then, as originally planned, I'll leave the conquest of $$新日本$$ to you.」

135:t_1:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Incidentally, according to our information, that famous $$ゼロ$$ is in $$新日本$$.」

135:t_1:19.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I've heard the rumors. He's a man who's won countless victories through his strategic skill.」

135:t_1:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「He's known as the man who works miracles... My, that sounds impressive.」

135:t_1:21.en:
$$ギルター$$
「But I will bury his legend. Look forward to the news of my victory!」

135:t_1:22.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「All right, all right. In light of your enthusiasm, I'll overlook your casual tone toward your superior this time.」

135:t_1:23.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Do your best, then. The boss has high expectations too.」

135:t_1:24.en:
$$ギルター$$
「H-He has high expectations of me...!」

135:t_1:25.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I cannot fail...! I must make up for my failure on $$翠の地球$$ here!」

135:t_1:26.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I've already found the key point for conquering $$新日本$$... All that remains is for me to take command and settle the battle in one stroke...!」

135:t_1:27.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Just you wait, $$ゼロ$$! The one who works miracles will be me... $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

135:t_1:33.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Apart from a skirmish on the $$ホッカイドウ$$ front, things are calm in every theater at present.」

135:t_1:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's probably the calm before the storm.」

135:t_1:35.en:
$$扇$$
「Is an all-out attack coming after this?」

135:t_1:38.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... Perhaps returning to your old home has made you even bolder than before.」

135:t_1:39.en:
$$千葉$$
「You dispersed our troops across the fronts, leaving $$トウキョウ$$ thinly defended. What are you planning, $$ゼロ$$?」

135:t_1:40.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even with civilian support and reinforcements from Japan, we don't have that many troops to defend $$新日本$$.」

135:t_1:41.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Trying to protect everything would instead mean losing everything.」

135:t_1:42.en:
$$千葉$$
「Even so, if $$トウキョウ$$, the heart of $$新日本$$, were to fall...!」

135:t_1:43.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I'll answer $$扇$$'s earlier question about whether an all-out attack is coming.」

135:t_1:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「An all-out attack isn't simply coming. We're going to make them launch it.」

135:t_1:47.en:
$$千葉$$
「Don't tell me... you're luring the enemy forces here to $$トウキョウ$$?」

135:t_1:48.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Exactly. ...From the past few days' data, it appears the Empire has changed the commander of its invasion of $$新日本$$.」

135:t_1:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That man is certain to attack $$トウキョウ$$. If we crush him, the tide will turn sharply in our favor.」

135:t_1:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then that's fine too. We can use the forces that would have gone to $$トウキョウ$$ to protect other regions.」

135:t_1:52.en:
$$千葉$$
「Isn't that just an armchair theory?」

135:t_1:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「In my assessment, the new commander is the following sort of man.」

135:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「He has immense confidence in his strategic skill. He aims to turn difficult situations around and achieve maximum results with few troops.」

135:t_1:55.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... He truly is a man who works miracles.」

135:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But he's also vain and overconfident, which leaves him vulnerable to changes in the situation. He lacks flexibility and the ability to react quickly.」

135:t_1:58.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「In other words, he's an easy mark?」

135:t_1:59.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At least, he's no match for me.」

135:t_1:60.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Very well, $$ゼロ$$. Since I entrusted $$新日本$$'s defense to you, I won't demand an explanation.」

135:t_1:61.en:
$$藤堂$$
「I'll take responsibility. Deploy us however you see fit.」

135:t_1:63.en:
$$藤堂$$
「What this country needs now is victory, more than a hundred words of thanks. Don't forget that.」

135:t_1:64.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Of course. I promise to protect $$新日本$$.」

135:t_1:65.en:
$$千葉$$
「There's a transmission from $$カトル$$ at the front. $$サイデリアル$$ forces are reportedly heading for $$トウキョウ$$.」

135:t_1:67.en:
$$扇$$
「But, $$ゼロ$$...! If we fight without $$カレン$$ and $$スザク$$...」

135:t_1:68.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I have a plan for that too. ...$$藤堂$$, I'm counting on you and $$千葉$$ to command the rear.」

135:t_1:69.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Are you going to the front yourself?」

135:t_1:70.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The enemy commander is coming out personally too. I must meet him.」

135:t_1:71.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And I'll teach him... the anger of those robbed by people who aren't prepared to be shot themselves.」

135:t_2:4.en:
$$扇$$
「Good work, $$カレン$$. I'm glad you came back.」

135:t_2:6.en:
$$扇$$
「...$$ゼクス$$ reported what happened to $$第３新東京市$$ and $$シンジ$$ and the others.」

135:t_2:7.en:
$$扇$$
「For now, let's believe they're safe and do everything we can ourselves.」

135:t_2:9.en:
$$スザク$$
「...It sounds like you used quite a bold strategy, $$ゼロ$$.」

135:t_2:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We had limited forces to deploy. I merely chose the most efficient tactics, prepared to accept some casualties.」

135:t_2:11.en:
$n
「I know we're short on resources, but...」

135:t_2:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I think having even civilians take part in the fighting is going too far.」

135:t_2:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No... His point is entirely reasonable.」

135:t_2:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let me ask you instead. You and $n aren't soldiers either, but you fight with $c, don't you?」
